signal: NetBrain closed a majority investment from Blackstone Growth in Jan 2026, named a new CEO, and launched Agentic AI for network operations

email.body1:
Pedram, saw NetBrain close the Blackstone Growth investment, bring in a new CEO, and launch Agentic AI for network operations.

A shift that big usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that gap is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for NetBrain off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Pedram, quick follow-up for NetBrain.

Post-investment, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most VPs of Sales don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings NetBrain needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Pedram, last bit of proof for NetBrain.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how NetBrain's reply rate likely compares to peer network-software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Pedram, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. A new CEO and a fresh raise make for their own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to NetBrain's motion? I'll tailor it to you either way.
